neighbours.label: describing what a material is ('a solid material', 'naturally occurring', 'natural compounds')
fire: A metal is a solid material that conducts heat.
Quartz is one of the most common naturally occurring minerals.
Rocks are natural aggregates of minerals.
Salt is a crystalline solid at room temperature.
Graphite is a naturally occurring form of carbon.
Amber is a natural resin from trees.
Granite is a hard natural stone.
Ice is the solid form of water.
quiet: A teacher is a kind person who helps children.
Quartz is one of the most popular kitchen counters.
Rocks are on the path near the lake.
Salt is on the table in the kitchen.
Graphite is in the pencil on my desk.
Granite is on sale at the store.
Ice is in the cooler by the door.
